ResearchProjectDef.label: soil budgeting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Track and restore field fertility as a budget. Harvests draw down soil strength; compost topdressing and residue return refill it. Exhausted budgets slow growth and can collapse engineered soils into hardpan. Pairs with Landworks terraforming when that mod is present.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->kept a dustworld farm alive through careful fallow cycles

ResearchProjectDef.label: compost works
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build compost pits and process hay, wood pulp, or plant residue into field compost for topdressing. More throughput than a crafting spot; still slow, dirty work.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->ran a municipal compost yard that fed three villages

ResearchProjectDef.label: crop rotation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Mark fields as fallow to slowly restore soil budget without planting. Inspect tools show last crop. Repeated mono-cropping of the same plant on a cell drains soil harder — rotate or rest the land.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->taught three-field fallow cycles to frontier farmers

ResearchProjectDef.label: paddy works
ResearchProjectDef.description: Form dry paddy beds and flood them for rice. Flooded paddies boost rice growth and hold soil budget better, but need labour to maintain. Unmaintained flooded paddies may dry out when soil is starved. Pairs naturally with Landworks drainage when present.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->built terraced paddies that outlasted three monsoons

ResearchProjectDef.label: green manuring
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow clover-style green manure and plow plants back into the soil to restore budget without harvest yield. Also unlocks plow-in orders for haygrass and other suitable crops.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->turned exhausted plots green again with plow-down clover
